title: meta.json
description: Document metadata written next to document.pdf in inbox/<YYYY-MM-DD-slug>/. Writers must emit id, title and createdAt. Readers must tolerate their absence: the app falls back to the filename for the title and to origin.kind 'manual' for everything under origin (docs/04-flows.md, failure handling). Unknown keys are ignored, never rejected.

id.description: The writing tool's identifier for this document, verbatim. A UUID string is preferred but not required; the app keeps whatever it is given and mints its own UUID alongside.

title.description: Display title. When absent the app uses the PDF metadata title, the markdown H1, then the filename, in that order.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601. The app writes second precision with a Z suffix; it parses fractional seconds and numeric offsets too.

sourceFormat.description: What the document was before rendering. 'markdown' implies source.md, and usually sourcemap.json, sit alongside document.pdf.

pageCount.description: Written by the ingesting app, not by the sender: a markdown sender cannot know it, because pagination happens when the iPad renders the PDF. Optional and advisory when a sender does write it; the authoritative count comes from the rendered PDF.

sourceURL.description: Absolute URL this document came from on the web, when it came from the web. The share extension records it for a shared link — it does no network work of its own, so the app fetches and renders the page later. Optional; nothing in ingest branches on it.

tags.description: Free-form labels from the writing tool — the MCP server's send_to_ipad passes these through. Carried with the document and shown in the library; nothing in the app branches on them.

origin.description: Where the document came from. Every field is optional; a document with no origin at all is still perfectly readable.

kind.description: Note the hyphen in claude-code. 'note' means the document was written in the app rather than sent to it. An unrecognised value is read as 'manual'.

sessionId.description: Cowork session id, Claude Code hook session_id, or the Codex equivalent. Without it no return path can preserve thread context. This is the canonical location; a copy under returnPath is tolerated and ignored.

threadTitle.description: Human-facing conversation title, shown on the review sheet's destination row before the user commits.

returnPath.description: How a finished review gets back. Absent means no automated path, which is a supported outcome: the app falls back to copy, share sheet and save.

type.description: An unrecognised value is read as 'none'.

triggerId.description: The scheduled task bound to the originating session. Allowed on any type, not only 'poke': a 'checkin' task has an id too, and the Mac-side watcher uses it to deduplicate. The task must exist before meta.json is written — see docs/06-integrations.md.

detail.description: Free text carried through untouched, e.g. a working directory for --resume.
